items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I heard she died. I don't know if I'm true.

ctx.x: Uh-uh. No, we just learned our own stuff. Everybody learned their own stuff.
What ever happened to Lewis' sister, you know? Mama Lucy, you called her?
Yeah? No, I heard she died. I don't know if I'm true. I heard she died.
